links.outcome: Interpretation quality across four languages using scripted ICU scenarios
links.effect: Composite scores were acceptable (≥16/20) across all languages. Spanish and Turkish performed consistently well; Chinese and Arabic showed variability due to omissions and terminology errors.
links.quote: Spanish and Turkish performed consistently well; Chinese and Arabic showed variability due to omissions and terminology errors.

screen.reason: Evaluates the translation accuracy and quality of a speech-based multilingual interpretation tool using scripted ICU simulation scenarios with bilingual evaluators.
